name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
summary: Promotes cluster development to organize traditional industries and artisans for sustainable employment and profitability.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: Grant assistance for hard and soft cluster interventions managed via Special Purpose Vehicles.

criteria.description: The turnover of the implementing organization should be at least Rs. 25 lakhs per year.
criteria.source_quote: The turnover of the organization should be atleast Rs.25 lakhs per year.

criteria.description: Implementing Agency should have a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in related activities specific to the proposed cluster.
criteria.source_quote: The proposed Implementing Agency should have a minimum 3 years of relevant experience in related activities specific to the proposed cluster.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepared by the Implementing Agency detailing the cluster setup
Must provide balance sheet verifying an annual turnover of over Rs. 25 Lakhs
Certificate of incorporation or society registration for NGOs and Agencies

windows.notes: Applications are accepted based on Nodal Agency open calls.

benefits.description: Financial assistance for cluster formation and common facility setups
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Disbursed to the Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) ensuring sustainability beyond the project period.
benefits.source_quote: The Revamped SFURTI Cluster will intensify the sustainability of the programme beyond the project period through creation of Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV)
